Name: Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements for Content Patcher
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
Thanks to Tanpoponoko for letting me convert & upload [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2380]Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements[/url]﻿ to Content Patcher!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]﻿

This mod does not include all of the custom map elements added by TCME. The [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/2380/2380-1528843660-268192673.png]gazebo[/url] is not included because there is no sprite big enough to be replaced. Nor is the [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/2380/2380-1528843677-2089389208.png]tree[/url]﻿ because I'm not sure what to be replaced. 

Config Options:
[list]
[*]Well: "enabled, disabled"
[*]WaterObelisk: "enabled, disabled"
[*]EarthObelisk: "enabled, disabled"
[*]StatueOfPerfection: "enabled, disabled"
[*]StatueOfEndlessFortune: "enabled, disabled"
[/list]
Default is all will be enabled
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Install Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿. 
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Remove [CP] Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements from your /Mods folder
[/list]
